_comment: Reviewed exceptions for tools/check_page_sizes.py. Key = repo-relative path, value = the review's stated reason for keeping the page unsplit despite crossing the size threshold. No blanket allowlist entries - each key must name a specific, reviewed page.
12_Engineering_and_Systems/analysis/Ligh: Reviewed 2026-09-01, the first entry in this file. This page was MERGED section by section on 2026-09-01 from 31 fragmented sections into 9 organised by decision, and the section structure was the deliverable of that work; it now stands at 11 top-level sections, below the 12-section cluster trigger. It crossed the flat 400-line threshold by ~10 lines when Round 5 added three dissents (dimmers as an interface, a third distinct cove-lighting objection, and a too-much-light ranking) plus two pendant items. It cannot shrink without losing content, and splitting it would undo a merge performed deliberately to fix the opposite failure. Per 00_Master/wiki_page_format.md, line count is the weakest of the available signals. REVIEW AGAIN if the section count reaches 12, which would mean the fragmentation is returning - that, not the line count, is the signal that matters for this page.
